name: SmartParallax – GPU Parallax Backgrounds & Scroll Effects
author: smartparallax

sections.description:
SmartParallax adds fluid, GPU-accelerated parallax motion to WordPress blocks, images, headings, and sections.
Backgrounds, containers, and elements can smoothly move based on scroll position, powered by a tiny JavaScript engine running fully on the GPU.

The plugin integrates seamlessly with Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks, Divi, Oxygen, and classic themes — without dependencies.

🔥 Highlights

  • Smooth, GPU-accelerated parallax motion
  • Background parallax using .parallax-image
  • Container parallax via .parallax-container
  • Horizontal motion using .parallax-x
  • All-direction parallax (.parallax-xy)
  • Stop-sensitive behavior using -s modifiers
  • Speed modifiers (parallax-3, parallax--05, etc.)
  • Automatic background-layer injection
  • Lightweight, dependency-free JS engine

Live Demo & Documentation

https://smartparallax.com/

Available Classes

Class
Description

.parallax-image
Creates a moving background layer

.parallax-container
Moves an entire block or section

.parallax-x
Enables horizontal parallax motion

.parallax-xy
Enables multi-direction parallax

.parallax-(--)
Adjusts speed (e.g. .parallax-05, .parallax--03)

.parallax-[…]-s
Stop-sensitive motion (movement stops after center)

License

SmartParallax is open-source software licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/smart-parallax/,
    or install it directly via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate SmartParallax.
  3. Add one of the provided CSS classes (such as .parallax-image) to any block or container.
sections.faq:
Does SmartParallax use JavaScript?

Yes. It uses a small, dependency-free engine to calculate motion and apply GPU transforms for smooth performance.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes. SmartParallax works with Gutenberg, Elementor, Bricks, Divi, Oxygen, WPBakery, and most theme builders.

Will it slow down my website?

No. The engine is extremely lightweight and fully GPU-accelerated.
